description: Verifies the ephemeris primitives: calendar to Julian date conversion at J2000 and one year later, and the conversion of the osculating elements of the Earth into a state vector with the expected heliocentric distance and orbital speed.

checks.label: 1 January 2000 at noon is the Julian date 2451545
J2000 corresponds to zero seconds past J2000
1 January 2001 at noon is the Julian date 2451911
the eccentric anomaly stays within 0.04 rad of the mean anomaly for a small eccentricity
the true anomaly stays within 0.04 rad of the mean anomaly for a small eccentricity
the heliocentric distance stays within 2 percent of one astronomical unit
the orbital speed lies between 29 and 31 kilometres per second
